51243508.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Bcl6 (unknown origin) by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Experimental Section - General: Kinetics data were obtained using a Biacore direct binding assay and immobilization of target via nickel capture and NHS/EDC amine coupling to a NTA Biacore sensor chip; analyses were performed in the Biacore T200 BIA evaluation software. Images of ligand–target complexes were generated using MOE. The log D values were determined at pH 7.4 using shake flask methodologies. Alternatively, clogD values (2 and 8) were calculated using a conformal SVM signature model based on measured data of compounds within and beyond the same series.
original_paragraph.Figure 11 caption: Figure 11. Structure–kinetics relationships for BCL6 inhibitors. (a) A flexible acyclic inhibitor (¹H, DMSO-d₆ 30 °C, 400 MHz) with suboptimal on-rate kinetics. Protein–ligand complex crystal structure is PDB code SN21. (b) A cyclized analog (¹H, DMSO-d₆ 30 °C, 400 MHz) with 50-fold higher affinity significantly assisted by preorganization into the bioactive conformation, 17 is shown docked into PDB code SN21 (see Supporting Information Table S4). (c) A further 3.3-fold improvement in affinity is dominated by off-rate kinetics by increasing ligand–protein interactions. Protein–ligand complex crystal structure is PDB code SN1Z. An increase in protein complementarity arises from the engagement of ligand to protein Arg-28 polar interactions, leading to increased residence time.
original_paragraph.Figure 11 data: Figure 11a: BCL6 SPR Kd 1100 nM, kon = 0.7 x 10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, koff = 0.77 s⁻¹, t1/2 = 0.02 min, logD (pH 7.4) -0.4. Figure 11b: BCL6 SPR Kd 22 nM, kon = 5.5 x 10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, koff = 0.14 s⁻¹, t1/2 = 0.1 min, logD (pH 7.4) 2.4. Figure 11c: BCL6 SPR Kd 6.5 nM, kon = 1.6 x 10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, koff = 0.0083 s⁻¹, t1/2 = 2 min, logD (pH 7.4) 2.2.
original_paragraph.Table 1: Table 1. Potency Is Driven by Free-Ligand Preorganization into the Bioactive Conformation. Compounds 16, 17, and 3 are listed with SPR Kd (nM) values of 1100, 22, and 6.5, respectively. The k_on (μM⁻¹ s⁻¹) values are 0.7, 5.5, and 1.6, and the k_off (ms⁻¹) values are 770, 140, and 8.3.

original_paragraph.Experimental Section - General: Kinetics data were obtained using a Biacore direct binding assay and immobilization of target via nickel capture and NHS/EDC amine coupling to a NTA Biacore sensor chip; analyses were performed in the Biacore T200 BIA evaluation software. Images of ligand–target complexes were generated using MOE. The log D values were determined at pH 7.4 using shake flask methodologies. Alternatively, clogD values (2 and 8) were calculated using a conformal SVM signature model based on measured data of compounds within and beyond the same series.
original_paragraph.Figure 10 caption: Structure–kinetic relationships for Mcl-1 inhibitors that preorganize into the bioactive conformation as free ligands in solution. (a) 15 (¹H, DMSO-d₆, 27 °C, 400 MHz). The bioactive conformation was determined from docking into PDB code SMES (which has a chlorine atom in place of the methyl sulfone; see Supporting Information Table S4). (b) 1 (¹H, DMSO-d₆, 27 °C, 600 MHz), adopts the bioactive conformation seen in PDB code 6FS0. The two molecules (1 and 15) have similar on-rate kinetic constants, as expected from ligand preorganization into the bioactive state, so the 100-fold difference in affinity is reflected in the 100-fold difference in off-rate kinetics.
original_paragraph.Figure 10 data: Mcl-1 SPR Kd 20 nM, kon = 3.3 x 10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, koff = 0.066 s⁻¹, t1/2 = 0.3 min, logD (pH 7.4) 4.1 for compound 15. Mcl-1 SPR Kd 0.2 nM, kon = 3.8 x 10⁶ M⁻¹s⁻¹, koff = 0.0006 s⁻¹, t1/2 = 30 min, logD (pH 7.4) 3.1 for compound 1.
original_paragraph.Table 1: For compound 1: SPR Kd (nM) = 0.2, kon (μM⁻¹ s⁻¹) = 3.8, koff (ms⁻¹) = 0.6. For compound 15: SPR Kd (nM) = 20, kon (μM⁻¹ s⁻¹) = 0.05, koff (ms⁻¹) = 158.
